title: Nile Felucca
summary: The triangular sail of the river boat: the wind shifts along the bends, and you keep the sail trimmed to the gold marker as it moves.
howToPlay: Hold the left or the right side to ease or haul the sail.
Keep the white dot on the gold marker: it follows the wind as it shifts.
Stay on it as you pass the buoys.
rules: Speed comes from how well the sail matches the wind.
The river current gives every boat a small push downstream.
Buoys are cleared when your trim is right as you reach them.
heritageNote: Feluccas have carried goods and passengers up and down the Nile for centuries; their lateen sail lets them sail upstream into the prevailing wind.
